ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Government Programs
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent trend of fraud in government programs, including childcare and autism programs. It would examine the ways in which fraud is perpetuated and the measures being taken to prevent it.
questions: What are the most common types of fraud in government programs?
How can we prevent fraud in these programs?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the need for increased oversight and accountability in government programs.
